split_policy: All source photos and their derivatives remain train; preserve baseline val and test pixels and labels.

augmentation.geometry_policy: Preserve observed lid state, attached lid silhouette and aspect ratio; compatible observed front/rear groups for multi-bin scenes; no invented camera views.
augmentation.occlusion_policy: Use visible whole-bin boxes including attached lid; protect the upper 45 percent of each source mask as a conservative state-evidence region. Record measured visibility and any layout fallback.

evaluation_scope: Old Val and Test are known regression sets; source photos are one session and not independent validation.
limitations: One physical bin per color; actual view and state counts are in the annotation manifest.
Only gray closed has confirmed low-view photos; medium front/rear cover all colors and states. No new calibrated low open or overhead views can be generated from these photos.
Unpaired camera views remain original direct photos; cutout synthesis only amplifies view groups supported by both states of the same color.
Composites are approximate camera/view-compatible layouts, not calibrated 3D reconstructions or independent real scenes.
Frame-edge source photos marked composite_eligible=false remain direct-only.
